<decisions>
## Implementation Decisions

### Parallel Research Architecture
- Spawn 3-4 parallel agents for external research, each with a focused research prompt
- Research dimensions: (1) existing solutions/frameworks, (2) anti-patterns/pitfalls, (3) architecture patterns/prior art, (4) dependencies/compatibility
- Each agent uses the profile's discover_external model (default: Perplexity Sonar)
- Results merged into single external.md with per-track sections

### Failure Handling
- If any parallel track fails, remaining tracks still complete
- Failed tracks get TRACK_FAILED stub in the merged external.md
- Overall discovery succeeds as long as at least one external track completes

### Claude's Discretion
- Agent spawning mechanism (Task tool vs Bash subprocess)
- Merge strategy (concatenate vs structured interleave)
- Whether to add a seraphim-discover-researcher agent definition or use inline prompts

</decisions>
